states.changed: A reader points at any of the 80 report days in a funnel, sees that day zone by zone, and sees on a strip of the table's column labels that both outlying days carry the same wording as their neighbours.

A fourth figure sets Ituri's 51 report days from 30 August to 1 November in order, shades the days whose line on the dead writes failures, and shows beside them the two pooled shares (33.1 % and 28.3 %) with their intervals; a reader can read each day's line and count, and move the share to the next report day.
